items.en: «Дроноводов ВСУ привлекли для тестирования Skyranger в Швеции» (Topwar: 'Ukrainian drone operators brought in to test Skyranger in Sweden') — Rheinmetall calls results unsatisfactory
items.nl: Topwar: 'Oekraïense droneoperators ingezet om Skyranger in Zweden te testen' — Rheinmetall noemt resultaten onvoldoende
items.sEn: Citing the German newspaper Welt am Sonntag, Topwar reports that Rheinmetall has called the results of tests of its Skyranger counter-drone air-defence system in Sweden unsatisfactory. items.en: Rheinmetall calls a live test of the Bundeswehr's Skyranger in Sweden against Ukrainian drone pilots unsatisfactory; proof firing set for April and serial vehicles on the new B0 drive module for Q3 2027
items.nl: Rheinmetall noemt live-test van de Skyranger voor de Bundeswehr in Zweden tegen Oekraïense dronepiloten onbevredigend; bewijsschieten gepland voor april, seriële voertuigen op de nieuwe B0-rijmodule in het derde kwartaal van 2027
items.sEn: A Rheinmetall spokesperson told the German weekly Welt am Sonntag that a live test of the Skyranger counter-drone system in Sweden, flown against Ukrainian drone pilots, produced an unsatisfactory result, according to a report by the German news agency dts published on 31 October. items.en: Ukraine's General Staff says it shot down nearly 60% of Russian jet-powered Geran-4 drones over the past three months
items.nl: Oekraïense Generale Staf: bijna 60% van de Russische straalaangedreven Geran-4-drones in de afgelopen drie maanden neergehaald
items.sEn: In an update on its Telegram channel on 27 October 2026, Ukraine's General Staff said the shoot-down rate of Russia's jet-powered Geran drones is steadily rising. items.sNl: De Oekraïense Generale Staf meldde op 27 oktober 2026 via Telegram dat steeds meer Russische straalaangedreven Geran-drones worden neergehaald.
